source.author: verg
source.text: Dixerat, et dextra discedens impulit altam haud ignara modi puppim: fugit illa per undas ocior et iaculo et ventos aequante sagitta.
source.text_original: Dixerat, et dextra discedens impulit altam / haud ignara modi puppim: fugit illa per undas / ocior et iaculo et ventos aequante sagitta.
source.text_english: He had spoken, and, departing with his right hand, gave a push to the lofty stern, not unskilled in the way: it fled over the waves swifter than spear and arrow that rivals the winds.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: at cuncti fremere intus et aequora venti poscere.
reuse.text_original: at cuncti fremere intus et aequora venti / poscere.
reuse.text_english: But all within were roaring and demanding the seas for the winds.
